title: v2.1.248: --restricted sandbox mode, cross-session messaging on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry, /usage-credits
description: v2.1.248 adds a `--restricted` mode that removes command/code-execution tools and WebFetch, keeps file tools sandboxed to the working directory, and ignores local settings files; expands cross-session messaging (SendMessage/ListAgents) to Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry; adds /usage-credits for Enterprise orgs to request higher limits; and adds experimental per-agent prompt-cache TTL (cacheTtl).

title: Cloud Agents: Start from scratch without a repo, live preview, Vercel publishing
description: Cloud Agents no longer need a connected GitHub or other SCM provider to start work — 'Start from scratch' creates an Origin repo behind the scenes, with a Create repo button to save agent work. Live preview port-forwards the agent's environment to the browser, and agents can publish to a live URL via a connected Vercel account.

community_feedback.quote: [I] wish [they] keep the Cursor brand and vision of an E2E Developer platform from Origin to Cloud Agents intact.

title: Copilot code review: Resolution reasons and expanded capabilities
description: Copilot code review now reports resolution reasons and gains expanded capabilities, helping developers understand why suggested changes were or weren't applied when Copilot reviews pull requests.

title: Global model policy generally available
description: GitHub's global model policy for Copilot is now generally available, giving administrators a single policy to govern which AI models are available across their organization.

title: Automations and Slack upgrades: queued messages, multi-channel triggers, batch security remediation
description: Devin's August 26 release adds queued message delivery during long waits, smarter @mention routing to subscribed sessions, automation triggers across multiple Slack channels, an 'Improve with Devin' action for iterating on automations, Jira status_changed triggers, batch remediation of security findings via new v3 API routes, and an org setting allowing sessions to open PRs as validated collaborators.

title: Codex CLI 0.150.0: @-mention other Codex tasks, /copy picker, Interrupt hooks
description: Codex CLI 0.150.0 lets users reference other Codex tasks with @ mentions and ask agents to read, create, or message tasks from the terminal; /copy gains a picker for full responses, code blocks, and blockquotes; task titles are auto-generated with /rename suggestions; new Interrupt hooks were added. Security fixes ensure untrusted projects no longer inject project-level AGENTS.md instructions. Patch 0.150.1 (Aug 27) fixes remote compaction image token budgets.

title: GitHub Copilot app Customize tab is generally available
description: The Customize tab in the GitHub Copilot app reached general availability, letting users tailor Copilot's behavior, instructions, and tooling from a dedicated UI surface.

title: Event-triggered scheduled tasks for Codex (Gmail, Slack, GitHub events)
description: Scheduled tasks can now run on Gmail, Slack, or GitHub events — e.g. filtered Gmail messages, watched Slack channels, or PR activity like reviews and merges — available on web and mobile for eligible plans, complementing time-based schedules.

title: Gemini CLI v0.57.0: OAuth fixes for Cloud Workstations, capacity-aware retries, IDE connection fixes
description: Gemini CLI's v0.57.0 weekly stable release dynamically resolves Cloud Workstations proxy redirect URIs for OAuth flows, fixes swallowed directory mismatches in IDE connections, adds context-aware silent retries with availability TTL for capacity errors, rolls back entire multi-turn requests on cancellation, prevents indefinite TUI hangs via execution timeouts, and improves evals with tool-call formatting and failure summaries.

community_feedback.quote: lost my context. I had good context, this is what was the most important thing. Now it's trashed.
Since the latter product has been discontinued, I think I'm entitled to a refund.

title: `codex mcp-server` deprecated in favor of Codex app server
description: OpenAI deprecated the `codex mcp-server` command in favor of the Codex app server, pointing Claude Code users to the Codex plugin for integration.

title: The new GitHub Copilot experience in Slack
description: A refreshed GitHub Copilot experience for Slack shipped as a release, letting users invoke Copilot and its agents directly from Slack conversations as part of GitHub's collaboration tools refresh.

title: Shared agentic work with GitHub Copilot in Microsoft Teams
description: GitHub Copilot brings shared agentic work to Microsoft Teams, enabling teams to collaborate with Copilot agents inside Teams channels — part of GitHub's push to embed agentic coding in workplace collaboration tools.

title: Windsurf/Devin Desktop v3.8.20: multi-window Agent Command Center, Devin Local plan mode
description: Windsurf (now Devin Desktop under Cognition) v3.8.20 ships Agent Command Center improvements (follows selected space, in-place conversion, side-by-side agent windows, optional separate window via devin.agentWindow.location), faster Agent/Editor mode switching (Ctrl/Cmd+G), untrusted-workspace trust prompts, and a Devin CLI shim. Devin Local adds multi-root workspaces, plan mode producing a Markdown plan file with an Implement button, individually stoppable subagents, and post_setup_worktree hooks. Devin Cloud improves session filtering and live shell output streaming.

title: Session experience redesign: nested sub-Devin trees, session subscribers, custom sidebar tabs
description: Devin redesigned the session page with a compact header with built-in tags, a redesigned sessions sidebar with custom nav tabs/grouping/filtering, sub-Devin sessions displayed as a nested tree, session subscribers (follow and view others' sessions), bearer-token auth for automation webhooks, and expanded security-scan controls (change scan profiles, effort levels, incremental scan v3 endpoints).

title: Codex CLI 0.149.0: interactive `codex agents` dashboard, `codex queue`, /cd commands
description: Codex CLI 0.149.0 adds an interactive `codex agents` dashboard for managing sessions, /cd, /pwd and /cwd commands, `codex queue` for messaging existing sessions, expanded Vim motions, broader `codex doctor` diagnostics, and SDK support for exact config overrides plus max/ultra reasoning effort. Fixes include queued-message wake-ups, permission-profile restoration on resume, and Windows Terminal scrollback history.

community_feedback.quote: Codex won five of the six open-ended design rounds... Codex used nine agents and finished in ~5 hours; Claude Code used 25.
Impressions two weeks after moving from Claude Code to [Codex]: Claude Code has a more mature plugin system and richer skills frontmatter.

title: Cloud Agents and Cursor Harness improvements: subscriptions, isolated subagents, /goal
description: Cursor's agent harness update adds Subscriptions (cloud agents monitor PRs, watch Slack threads, or run scheduled tasks and wake on events, auto-subscribing to PRs they create), custom modes pinnable in chat, subagents running on isolated VMs with clean project copies, /goal for long-lived objectives (e.g. fixing flaky tests until CI is green), and steering improvements where follow-ups wait for the next tool call.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor is evolving so quickly that it's becoming difficult to keep track of all the updates.
The update experience is being actively improved right now.

title: GPT-5.6 Sol available at 70% discount on Devin Desktop and CLI
description: Cognition announced that GPT-5.6 Sol is available at a 70% discount on Devin Desktop and Devin CLI through October 3, 2026, lowering the cost of running OpenAI's model on Devin's platform.

title: /design research preview, Concise output style, and device cards (Week 34 updates)
description: Claude Code introduced a /design research preview bringing an artboard workflow to CLI and Desktop (Claude drafts editable artboards and builds the chosen one), a built-in Concise output style that leads with results, device cards via `claude remote-control` for starting sessions from a phone, and an ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL env var for setting the default starting model. Shipped across v2.1.234–v2.1.239.

title: Origin Code Hosting: Cursor now hosts your code
description: Cursor launched Origin code hosting in early beta on all paid plans: Origin Repos managed via a new Codebase tab, GitHub repo sync for browsing/searching (GitHub remains source of truth), PR views with timelines/checks/diffs and two-way comment sync, agents in every repo, and app extensions (Vercel preview deployments, Depot, Buildkite CI).

title: Grok 4.6 is now available in GitHub Copilot
description: xAI's Grok 4.6 model is now selectable in GitHub Copilot's model picker, continuing GitHub's multi-model strategy alongside Claude, GPT, and Gemini options.

title: Devin Coach and August 14 release: prompt suggestions, Devin Review skip logic, Devin Local default for enterprise
description: Devin shipped Devin Coach (suggestions in the input box to improve prompts before sending), Devin Review skipping re-review of PRs with unchanged diffs, session auto-subscription to Slack threads, teams chat polish, and Devin Local enabled by default for enterprise customers.

title: Auto mode becomes the default permission mode for new Claude Code sessions (effective Aug 14)
description: As of August 14, 2026, auto mode is the default permission mode for new Claude Code sessions on Pro, Max, and Team plans, with transcript protections that block dangerous operations while reducing permission prompts. Announced in the Week 32 notes; community discussion was extensive.

community_feedback.quote: Anthropic Flips Claude Code to Auto Mode by Default Aug 14, after finding AI blocks 80%+ dangerous queries while humans only 14%
there's plenty of 'optimization' around rubberbanding usage limits as well as routing to a different model in the backend. The incentives are too strong.
